summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Bladex (Foreign Trade Bank of Latin America, Inc.) reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. It discloses net profits of $56.4 million, earnings per share of $1.31, and a credit portfolio of $13,487 million. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or capital return is described. The filing is a routine earnings report and does not involve any transactional special situation.
